evidence: Touches `src/node/blockstorage.cpp` and carries the `Block storage` label, which is explicitly covered under validation.
rationale: Prevents overwriting block files and silently discarding chain data during a reindex when `blocks/xor.dat` is missing on an obfuscated node. When `xor.dat` is lost, the node currently writes an all-zero key and prompts a `-reindex` that resets the node to height 0 and destroys previous block data; while valuable for data recovery, this addresses an external file loss or tampering edge case rather than an in-band consensus or corruption bug.
